base: You get praised for being easy to work with, dependable, polished, or agreeable, and realize those are also the traits you have been using to hide what you actually want.
business: The two concerns arrive in the same decision; work with the point they now share.
shadow: Because both concerns are active at once, acting on one can obscure what the other still needs.
arcApplying: The two concerns become harder to separate as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The fused emphasis begins to loosen after exactness.

readerCopy.body: You get praised for being easy to work with, dependable, polished, or agreeable, and realize those are also the traits you have been using to hide what you actually want. When the Sun conjuncts Lilith, recognition can make the gap between being liked and being fully known much harder to ignore. The praise may be deserved. The problem is what you have had to leave out to keep receiving it. Notice where success depends on never being difficult, unconventional, angry, or honest about what does not work for you. Being appreciated should not require becoming easier to approve of than you actually are.
